entries: Small-eccentricity re-expression of near-circular DD/DDH orbits

Owner instruction 'Yes built it'. tools/orbit_reexpress.py converts T0/OM/ECC to TASC/EPS1/EPS2 with an equivalence check (0.1 TOA sigma). Simulated orbits agree to better than 0.01 sigma; an eccentric orbit is caught. Development preparation of the seven near-circular held targets, no search: J1933-6211 and J2322-2650 clear every check (equivalence 1e-7 sigma); J1101-6424 and J1903-7051 then fail on STIGMA; J1732-5049 and J2236-5527 on SINI range; J1751-2857 has no period range.
No observed search executed; development root not frozen. Searching the two cleared targets needs a new root and a new owner instruction.
